prompt_instructions: Do not reproduce a real celebrity without authorized reference.
Attach licensed face, styling and masthead assets before rendering.
Keep cover text as approved layout, never auto-generated substitutions.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end fashion magazine cover. Use the uploaded face for strict identity preservation. Aspect ratio 3:4, ultra-detailed, 8k, Met Gala red carpet event, direct flash photography, glamorous celebrity candid. Strictly preserve facial identity (eyes, nose, mouth) from the uploaded reference. Body proportions should be model-like and tall. Location: The Met Gala Red Carpet (New York), chaotic background with paparazzi cameras, red velvet ropes, bursts of camera flashes (bokeh orbs), dark night sky contrast, electric exclusive superstar energy. Direct Flash paparazzi lighting with high contrast hard light, glistening skin, sharp shadows behind subject and bright reflections on dress. Seductive confident smile looking back over shoulder, bold red lip, sharp contouring, glowing highlighter; walking away but turning head 45 degrees to look at camera, elegant posture, back slightly arched, hair blowing dramatically. Futuristic liquid-metal silver backless sequin gown, diamond choker and large stud earrings. Magazine Cover Layout: large bold Harper's BAZAAR logo at top in white or silver, Chinese text subtitles: 红毯之夜, 独家直击, 年度风尚大典. Luxurious, expensive, A-list celebrity, glossy magazine finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: low resolution, ugly hands, distorted face, missing logo, text error, watermark, casual clothing, daylight, soft lighting
